playbookOutputs: Completed SAPS 271 (Licence to Possess a Firearm) & SAPS 517 (Competency) Application Forms
Comprehensive Custom Section 13 / 15 / 16 / 20 Firearm Motivation Dossier, Safe Affidavit & Character Reference Letters
playbookCommonFailures: Firearm serial number or dealer SAPS 350(a) details do not match SAPS Central Firearms Register (CFR) records
Photographs of the firearm safe do not clearly show the internal rawl bolts anchoring the safe to a permanent wall/floor

informationToProvide.label: PFTC Firearm Training Provider Statement of Results
informationToProvide.aiHint: Training certificate showing proficiency in Knowledge of the Act and specific firearm category (Handgun/Shotgun/Rifle).

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copy (< 3 Months) & Proof of Residential Address (< 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your certified SA ID copy (< 3 months) and municipal utility bill / proof of residential address (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Certified South African ID (< 90 days) and proof of residential street address (< 90 days).

informationToProvide.label: SAPS Competency Certificate (If Already Issued) & Dealer Stock Return (SAPS 350a) / Firearm Make, Model, Calibre & Serial Number
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the firearm dealer SAPS 350(a) form / invoice showing the firearm make, model, calibre, action, and serial number, plus your SAPS Competency Certificate if already issued.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Firearm dealer invoice / SAPS 350(a) showing firearm particulars (type, action, calibre, make, model, serial number) and SAPS Competency Certificate.

informationToProvide.label: Colour Photographs of Installed SABS-Approved Gun Safe (Showing Open Door, Locking Mechanism & Rawl Bolts Into Wall/Floor)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload clear photographs of your installed SABS-approved firearm safe showing it bolted into brick/concrete wall and floor.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Clear photographs of an SABS-approved firearm safe installed and bolted to the wall/floor.

informationToProvide.label: Personal Motivation Background & Two Character References (Spouse/Partner + Friend/Colleague Full Names, ID Numbers & Contact Details)
informationToProvide.helpText: Describe your personal risk profile / business duties / sport club membership for the comprehensive motivation letter, and provide the names, ID numbers, relationship, and phone numbers of at least 2 character references.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Review firearm category and personal motivation details
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Category, training certificate, and motivation factors collected

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft customized motivation document and SAPS checklists
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Motivation, safe affidavit, and referee letters compiled

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver pack and DFO police station lodgement guide
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Pack delivered to client for physical submission at local police station
